title: Plant-Environment Measurement & Crop Response
description: Specialist module covering representative environmental measurement, vapor-pressure/dew-point interpretation, lighting context, crop-response integration and data-quality reporting.
learningOutcomes: Design a representative environmental measurement plan that accounts for sensor placement, shielding, crop zone, spatial gradients, time-series behavior and calibration/verification status.
Interpret temperature and relative humidity together through vapor-pressure and dew-point concepts while distinguishing room-air conditions from leaf-surface conditions.
Relate PPFD, photoperiod and DLI measurements to crop-environment context without converting examples from other crops or studies into universal cannabis targets.
Analyze crop response alongside environmental measurements to distinguish true room events, local microclimates, sensor error and plant-specific conditions.
Produce a reconstructable environmental verification report that states measurement quality, observed pattern, confidence, limits, permitted action and escalation needs.
